assessment: Unused booked time and declined requests coexist, but neither suitable spare capacity nor flexible demand is established. One speculative capability merits a bounded test; the eight-week success target remains unproven.

openings.claim: A rehearsal obligation could retain a predictable confirmed slot while participating in a coordinated exchange of several groups’ room-times, potentially opening a suitable slot that no isolated booking change can release.
openings.delta: Replace inherited individual reservations with consented exchange cycles evaluated against actual rehearsal requirements. The speculative capability is to find and complete such cycles without increasing the volunteer’s workload.
openings.prediction: At least one unmet request can be accommodated through a fully accepted exchange cycle while every affected group retains its requested duration, required equipment and acceptable window. If no cycle exists after requirements are recorded, this capability offers no demonstrated gain for these requests.
openings.probe: Use the short contact conversations to record weekly rehearsal needs, acceptable windows, equipment and willingness to exchange. On paper, seek one cycle, preserving every requested weekly 60-minute minimum and the booked performances within existing rooms and staffed hours. Keep original reservations until all affected contacts consent by phone or in person; use one authoritative desk record and confirmed updates to its copy. Pilot one accepted cycle and record usable rehearsal time, access conflicts and all administration minutes. Compare feasibility against simply assigning currently free slots; reject the claimed exchange benefit if free-slot assignment achieves the same result. Continue evaluation over eight weeks before claiming the stated success measure.
assumptions: Useful exchange cycles exist; aggregate vacancy alone does not establish this.
Dependencies include accurate group requirements, consent, coordinated calendar updates and reliable communication.
The presently testable partial capability is finding and completing one cycle manually; routine operation within two administration hours weekly is unproven.
